_mode_help: draft = AI writes a reply and sends it to you for approval; auto = AI replies straight away; off = nothing is sent, you just get alerts

_vipList_help: Numbers that never get an automatic reply. You're alerted and reply yourself. Example: ["+44 7700 900123"]
_allowList_help: If you put numbers here, ONLY these people get automatic replies. Leave empty for everyone.
_blockList_help: Numbers the bot ignores completely (no reply, no alert).
